2f3312c.summary: Shrinks the card to spell-played scale and disables its collider and UI highlights as it begins dissolving.

2f36940.summary: Destroys or exits all trait frame effects and active quest frame visuals on the card UI.

2f36608.summary: Starts the async state machine that undissolves the whole card.

2f36b7c.summary: Plays status animations for each current trait on summon or enchantment and applies special trait effects like drop pod stats and ability to act.

2f36f04.summary: Resets summon sickness and recomputes whether the unit can act or attack, updating the attack-ready indicator.

2f37000.summary: Sets the card state to in play and updates card visuals, highlight and trait icons.

2f3702c.summary: Sets the card state to in hand and updates card visuals, highlight and trait icons.

2f37058.summary: Resolves a non-targeted spell: triggers its effect, broadcasts it, then sends it to the cemetery or deactivates it if ephemeral.

2f37110.summary: Returns whether the card was played on the current turn.

2f36a1c.summary: Returns whether the card was drawn on the current turn.

2f371b0.summary: Resolves a targeted spell: triggers effects, handles synapse on friendly targets, then sends the spell to the cemetery.

2f37548.summary: Runs the synapse card's effect against each unit adjacent to this card.

2f376d0.summary: Triggers draw-related abilities on this card when a card is drawn, including armed trap handling.

2f37840.summary: Triggers the artifice ability when a friendly tactic is played.

2f378c8.summary: Checks whether a target is valid for the card's active ability.

2f37964.summary: Cancels an active ability, returns the card to in-play state and recomputes can-act and can-attack flags.

2f37d84.summary: Highlights blood thirst on the card UI and plays trigger animations for the blood thirst trait effects.

2f37dbc.summary: Creates the swarm icon if needed and activates it with sound and tween resets.

2f2dcf0.summary: Hides the swarm icon with a fade and move-back tween.

2f37cdc.summary: Builds a blood thirst highlight battle action and queues it as an instant action.

2f37f5c.summary: Returns the card highlight to its regular color with an animated or immediate transition.

2f35124.summary: Puts the card in attack-aiming state, starts attack targeting and launches the prepare-attack coroutine.

2f38198.summary: Cancels an attack in progress, clearing pending damage and restarting the prepare-attack coroutine, logging errors in dev mode.

2f38320.summary: Finishes an active ability, granting faith for pray under alternative trait logic, then runs the prepare-attack coroutine.

2f383c4.summary: Plays landing shake, sound and spawns landing particles at the card position.

2f38668.summary: Returns whether the card and its game object still exist so an animation can continue.

2f388a8.summary: Computes a rotation for the movement disappear animation by lerping toward an angle-axis rotation.

2f38a4c.summary: Plays attack shake, sound and hit particle effects sized by unit size at the anchor.

2f37ee0.summary: Returns the transform where effects should be anchored depending on card state.

2f38f80.summary: Plays the sneak attack trigger animation and its sound cue through the sound manager.

2f390ec.summary: Restores the card's position, rotation and scale after an attack and triggers blood thirst if it survives.

2f392b0.summary: Pushes the card back with a punch tween away from the attacker and returns it to position afterwards.

2f39680.summary: Plays a body animation clip on the 3D animation controller, optionally disabling flying first.

2f396a0.summary: Moves the card back to its original local position in play if it is not already there.

2f397cc.summary: Grants the opponent a skull when the hero's health drops and it is not dying from pending damage.

2f3996c.summary: Absorbs damage into bastion effects and trait value, returning the remaining bastion amount.

2f3826c.summary: Clears the pending damage list (decompiler output is mostly inlined array helper noise).

2f39b3c.summary: Appends a damage entry to the pending damage list, creating the list if needed.

2f2f848.summary: Returns whether the card's pending damage is enough to kill it, by collecting damage values and types.

2f39c84.summary: Simulates applying a list of pending damage values to the card, accounting for armour, dropPod, survivor, bastion and vulnerable, to see if it dies.

2f3a3c8.summary: Appends a heal entry to the pending healing list, creating the list if needed.

2f3a51c.summary: Returns whether the total pending healing is enough to restore the card to full health.

2f3a9f8.summary: Resolves triggers when a unit attacks: unit attack, mob, regiment, strike triggers, removes until-next-attack effects and clears ambush.
